en: The image depicts an old stone tower with battlements, situated between two urban buildings. The tower has a distinctive circular archway at the base, through which a street is visible. The lower part of the tower appears to be reflected in water, giving a surreal effect. There is also a modern street sign (no entry) to the right of the archway. The structure is medieval in style, suggesting a city gate or fortification.
